basic_details.job_title: HLL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Associate Manager / Operations Manager Posts
basic_details.short_information: HLL Lifecare Limited, a Government of India enterprise under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, is filling one Executive – Fixed Term Contract position of Associate Manager / Operations Manager (Civil/Structural) in the HCD (Projects & Services – Division), with posting at Faridkot. Basic pay is Rs. 25,000 – 45,000 per month for Associate Manager and Rs. 30,000 – 50,000 per month for Operations Manager. Applicants need BE / B.Tech (Civil) or Diploma in Engineering (Civil) with the stated experience and apply through a Google Form from 3 November 2026 to 18 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The maximum age is counted as on 01.11.2026. The notice states that the crucial date for the age limit is the same as the cut-off date for calculating qualification and post-qualification experience. | Post Degree Holders Diploma Holders Associate Manager Maximum 37 years Maximum 40 years Operations Manager Maximum 40 years Maximum 45 years | SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates are eligible for relaxation as per Government of India directives. Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. The notice does not mention a minimum age.

qualification.details: Post Degree Holders Diploma Holders Associate Manager Minimum 1 year Minimum 7 years Operations Manager Minimum 3 years Minimum 10 years | The experience must be in the planning, design, structural engineering, execution, supervision, quality control, testing and maintenance of civil and structural infrastructure for hospitals, medical colleges, super-specialty healthcare facilities, diagnostic centres, laboratories and allied healthcare projects.

how_to_apply: Open the Google Form through the Click here to Apply link given in the notice.
Download the prescribed job application form from the link provided in the form or from the HLL website.
Fill in the application form digitally and save it as a PDF or Word file. Handwritten applications will not be accepted.
Upload the completed application form using the file upload option in the Google Form. The maximum upload size is 10 MB per file.
Attach additional supporting documents in PDF or Word format if required (CV, educational/experience certificates, latest salary slip), each file under 10 MB.
Select the correct post applied for in the form.
Submit the form on or before the deadline. Late submissions will not be considered.

The job title and reference code (HLL/HR/109/2026) must be clearly mentioned in the application form. Applications not in the prescribed format will not be considered for the selection process, and no further communication will be sent separately.

content_sections.heading: About HLL
content_sections.text: HLL Lifecare Limited is a Government of India enterprise under the administrative control of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. The notice says it commenced operations on 5 April 1969 and now works across healthcare manufacturing, retail pharmacy, diagnostics, imaging services, healthcare infrastructure development, procurement consultancy and hospital management. It states an annual business turnover of approximately ₹6,500 crore.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The same qualification applies to both designations. The experience required depends on the designation and on whether the candidate holds a degree or a diploma. The experience must be in the planning, design, structural engineering, execution, supervision, quality control, testing and maintenance of civil and structural infrastructure for hospitals, medical colleges, super-specialty healthcare facilities, diagnostic centres, laboratories and allied healthcare projects. The maximum age is counted as on 01.11.2026. The notice states that the crucial date for the age limit is the same as the cut-off date for calculating qualification and post-qualification experience. SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates are eligible for relaxation as per Government of India directives. Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. The notice does not mention a minimum age.

content_sections.heading: HLL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Supervise civil / structural works at project sites, ensuring adherence to drawings, specifications, quality standards and timelines. Review structural drawings, designs, estimates and BOQs; verify measurements and contractor bills. Coordinate with contractors, structural consultants, architects and client authorities for smooth execution of projects. Ensure compliance with safety, statutory and quality requirements at site. Prepare progress reports and project documentation; support project handing over. Any other work assigned by the management from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HLL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the Google Form through the Click here to Apply link given in the notice. Download the prescribed job application form from the link provided in the form or from the HLL website. Fill in the application form digitally and save it as a PDF or Word file. Handwritten applications will not be accepted. Upload the completed application form using the file upload option in the Google Form. The maximum upload size is 10 MB per file. Attach additional supporting documents in PDF or Word format if required (CV, educational/experience certificates, latest salary slip), each file under 10 MB. Select the correct post applied for in the form. Submit the form on or before the deadline. Late submissions will not be considered. The job title and reference code (HLL/HR/109/2026) must be clearly mentioned in the application form. Applications not in the prescribed format will not be considered for the selection process, and no further communication will be sent separately. Completed application form in PDF or Word format CV, educational/experience certificates and latest salary slip, if required SC/ST Caste Certificate in the format applicable for appointment to posts under Government of India, for SC/ST candidates Other Backward Class Certificate (Non-Creamy Layer) in the format applicable for appointment to posts under Government of India, for OBC candidates No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of the interview, for candidates working in Government, Semi-Government Organizations, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice states that all information submitted in the application will be verified with original documents at the time of the interview. If any information is found to be false, incorrect or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria, the candidature is liable to be rejected or cancelled at any stage of the recruitment process. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice shows 1 position for Associate Manager / Operations Manager (Civil/Structural), with posting at Faridkot.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 18 November 2026, and the form opened on 3 November 2026. Late submissions will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is BE / B.Tech (Civil) OR Diploma in Engineering (Civil). ME / M.Tech (Structural Engineering) is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age as on 01.11.2026 is 37 years (Associate Manager) or 40 years (Operations Manager) for degree holders. For diploma holders it is 40 years (Associate Manager) or 45 years (Operations Manager).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Basic pay is Rs. 25,000 – 45,000 per month for Associate Manager and Rs. 30,000 – 50,000 per month for Operations Manager. Approximate gross salary at the minimum of the scale is Rs. 51,525.00 and Rs. 61,830.00 respectively (Non-Metro).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply through the Google Form linked in the notice. Upload the digitally filled application form in PDF or Word format, with supporting documents if required, and select the correct post.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The contract type is Executive – Fixed Term Contract.

faq.question: Q8. Do experience requirements differ for degree and diploma holders?
faq.answer: Yes. Degree holders need minimum 1 year (Associate Manager) or 3 years (Operations Manager). Diploma holders need minimum 7 years (Associate Manager) or 10 years (Operations Manager).

faq.question: Q9. Do government employees need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates working in Government, Semi-Government Organizations, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies must provide a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Are handwritten applications accepted?
faq.answer: No. The application form must be filled in digitally and saved as a PDF or Word file; handwritten applications will not be accepted.
